notes.title: Seeds of Friendship - Update 5
notes.notes:
Welcome to Update 5 for Seeds of Friendship. This update adds some of the most requested features from the Steam Community forums! The most important of all is a new Quest System that allowed me to build a Tutorial! Additionally several options have been added to the menus, the one I like the most is the sensitivity sliders for the camera's X and Y axis. The Harvestfest is now live, and while it's still a WIP you can get some unique items on this day just once a year! Finally, for the big time collectors out there I've added a collection tracker to the Town Hall. Now you can donate certain items to Blue, and she'll add them to the towns collection! Collect them all for an awesome achievement!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325318/dba977a6909a2545063281d0f83906cefc91e010.png

Changes:
Added Link to Aiden Stickland Musical Website
Improved Animal Sanctuary Signpost Visuals
Renamed "SpringFestival" to "Harvestfest"
On holidays characters will now start at the holiday site, instead of walking there from their home.
Characters have a "Default Rotation" for where they're standing during holiday events.
People will not wander on holidays.
Game messages will now come in multiple colors, red referring to actions you cannot perform. Green referring to positive messages like items received/quest complete.
The Vegetables on Wolfgang's Farmstead and Voyevodas Seedlings, will now be hidden turning fall/winter.
Animals will no longer cost 0 gold. Each has its own price.

Fixes :
Fixed a bug where the tool tip would not disappear if hovered over when menu is closed.
Fixed a bug where you could open the cell phone menu during cutscenes.
Fixed a bug where character dialog didn't work on holidays.
Fixed a bug where you couldn't exit the "Offer Gold" conversation with the (Action) button when talking to Ruckus.
Fixed a bug where some trees would spawn in houses.
Fixed a bug where planting a seed in the wrong season wouldn't restart animations.
Fixed a bug that allowed the player to harvest from Wolfgangs animals.
Fixed a bug where animal images weren't appearing in the animal purchase screen.

notes.title: Seeds of Friendship - Update 4 - Pre-Release Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DlsfwxReKcI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello! Welcome to the pre-release update to Seeds of Friendship. This will be the final update before the game becomes publicly available. This update rounds out the final touches that I wanted to have before launch, as well as several bug fixes. This updates key features include an app on the players cell phone that describes game play mechanics. Several pieces of furniture to round out Spiegels thrift stroe. Roughly 7 new songs, bringing the total soundtrack to 11 songs, and special SFX and UI improvements to help new players understand the game.

Changes:

 Updated character creator UI
 Updated EOD Screen
 Gave barn/coop sign post a model
 Increased overhead camera fov to 30
 Gave each season a unique % chance for rain
 New Dialog UI
 Fishing Pole added to craftable items list
 Adjusted code to help with adding new plants in the future
 Increased brightness in general
 Updated Heart Bar UI in Dialog UI
 Updated UI for items received
 Fixed Soil's hitboxes as they were slightly too far to the left
 Updated Shop UI
 Had a new trailer created
 New Hammer Model, Hammer is now Pickaxe
 New Axe Model
 Made some animations more fluid
 Changed local guide to "How To Play"


Fixes :


 Fixed a bug preventing the Hamster model from wearing clothing.
 Snow and rain should fail to collide with roofs far less often.
 Pumpkin lights should no longer flicker.
 Fixed a bug with clothing positioning on Monkey/Rabbit/Bear/Cat/Frog
 Fixed a bug where dragging and dropping items while in a shop would break the inventory.
 ProduceInTime interactables should now save properly.

 Fixed a bug causing an items value to be cut off in the tooltip.
 Fixed a bug causing a crop to not grow if it rained.
 Fixed a bug causing Blue to not give player hints.

 Removed post-processing effects from mini-map to improve performance.

 Fixed a bug where you could attempt to plant crops which would soft lock the game.

Additions:

I hope you guys enjoy Seeds of Friendship, I look forward to player feedback so we can make the game as great as it can be!

Thanks,
Adam

notes.title: Release Date - March 16th 2021 - Update 3
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5enaZ0XYzVM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone!

Today I am pleased to announce the release date for Seeds of Friendship - Early Access! The game will be releasing on March 16th, 2021 @3:00PM EST.

I've made a substantial number of additions over the last month, and I hope to implement many more before the release. One of the most notable additions this release is the character of Speigel Gottwald, a travelling salesman who comes to town on the 3rd and 8th of each month. He operates the Thrift Store in town where he will sell 3 different and random items each visit. Another change is the addition of the bee hive. The bee hive can be used to produce honey by adding sugar to it. To create a bee hive you'll have to catch quite a few bees, as well as a queen bee. Finally, and perhaps the most noticeable change is to the UI. The UI has been mostly overhauled with new images and layouts. They have not all be re-worked yet, but the ones that have been will give you an idea of the direction the others will be headed. The rest of the changes can be seen below and are as follows...

notes.title: Seeds of Friendship Update #2
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Kkh2Esxfe0g;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, it's been about a month since the last update and things are going well. The following video contains many of the changes and additions in this update, however I'd like to take a moment to point out some of the most important. There are now several escaped zoo animals running around the farmlands. Befriending one of these animals will open up access to the Old Animal Sanctuary. You can repair habitats in this area in order to give the escaped zoo animals a safe place to live. Each escaped zoo animal has a unique was to get it to join, so good luck with your rescuing! Another feature I feel greatly improves the game is the updated menu. It now appears as if it was a cell phone whos buttons bring you to different menu panels. Finally, there is now a placeholder introduction cutscene that should help explain some of the games areas and features. This is not the final version of this cutscene but I wanted to get something out there for people to see.

Changes

 Started changing the menu into a "Cell Phone" style menu.
 Increased the max slope angle the player could walk on.

Fixes

 Selecting an Item then closing the menu causes the item to stay on the screen.
 Fixed a bug involving occlusion culling of objects that had been destroyed.
 Fixed a bug where the wrong settings were running on startup, this was causing things like shadows to not appear.
 Fixed a bug where the character creator would display the wrong model first.
 Add a sound for the hoe.

Additions

 Added Algae Item.
 Added Boot Item.
 Added Bamboo Item.
 Added Item Cymbal.
 Added New Area for Animal Sanctuary
 Added Animal Sanctuary - Recruit Escaped Zoo Animals to your Animal Sanctuary.
